profile.headline: Experienced Full-Stack Engineer focused on empowering people, fostering decentralized collaboration, and delighting users.
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with 5+ years experience building delightful experiences to empower individuals with technology. I am a firm believer in the ability of technology to enrich our lives, and want to continue working on and building products which do so. The bulk of my professional experience has been in building API-driven services and rich user experiences using a variety of technologies including Python, TypeScript (React.js), and many others.

I am a graduate of Northern Kentucky University, where I earned a dual degree in Computer Information Technology and Media Informatics with a minor in the Honors College. During school I worked on projects that attempted to fuse the power of technology with individual and social improvement by allowing users more insight into their own personal data.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Beginning a journey into enterprise API management to support engineering agility and foster standards.
positions.insights: Skills: GitOps · API Management · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Primary Responsibilities:
- Developing and testing React/Typescript based user journeys to drive improvement for key metrics reflecting user success
- Integrate new projects with legacy systems leveraging appropriate technology for the scale and impact of the projects
- Consulting and development for nascent blockchain product relying on AWS Serverless architecture to quickly prototype and gather usage data
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Dynamodb · TypeScript · Redux.js · React.js · Serverless Framework

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Primary Responsibilities: 
- Research and Develop novel algorithms and mechanism to describe information markets
- Build full-stack architecture tools to connect users to a globally distributed back-end
- Create and maintain automated testing suites designed for maximum coverage in critical releases

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Primary Responsibilities:
- Use test-driven-development to contribute to a pre-existing suite of internal production tools built on python web frameworks and Ruby-on-rails.
- Co-lead green-field development of a new shipping API for contract-print customers to Teespring.
- Work in an Agile team to enhance Teespring's production and fulfillment capabilities. 
- Monitor logs and provide technical support to end users when problems in their workflow arrive.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities included: 
- Developing and Maintaining hundreds of marketing sites,
- Consulting for optimization of site speed, accessibility, etc,
- Serving as liaison between development team and upper-management.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Notable projects:
- Marketing animations on new anti-phishing program offered by company,
- 3D way-finding for Las Vegas Convention Center including directions to individual vendors

Along with these projects, I assisted development of consumer-facing marketing site while focusing on broadening skills into media-focused projects using primarily the Adobe Creative Suite.

positions.title: Peer Career Assistant
positions.description: Conduct mock interviews with peers and provide constructive feedback on improvements, present classroom announcements to faculty and classes on upcoming career events, and work individually and in a team on various projects in Career Services.
